last_assistant_message:
Research complete. Note: WebSearch/WebFetch tools were not available in this session, so I used curl plus a real Chrome session (Playwright) against Google/DuckDuckGo and direct site fetches. Key limitation: LinkedIn and people-data aggregators (ZoomInfo, Datanyze) are auth-walled/403, so his full employment history and education could not be extracted.

## Identity confirmed

This is a real, single person at VLink. He appears as **"Anthony Dillon"** on LinkedIn and on VLink's podcast/webinar pages, and as **"Tony Dillon"** on VLink's leadership page and in the Microsoft press release. His VLink speaker headshot file is literally `Tony-D.jpg` with alt text `"Tony Dillon VLink"`, which ties the two names together.

## 1. LinkedIn profile

- **URL: https://www.linkedin.com/in/anthony-dillon**
  - Source: DuckDuckGo HTML result resolving to `linkedin.com/in/anthony-dillon`, title "Anthony Dillon - VLink Inc | LinkedIn"; slug also confirmed by his own post URLs (`linkedin.com/posts/anthony-dillon_...`). Confidence: **high** (URL slug confirmed; page itself sits behind LinkedIn's authwall).
- **Headline (current): "Enterprise & Partner Sales Leader | Cloud & AI Transformation | Ex Microsoft"**, with company line **"AVP - Solution Sales & Partnership Alliance · VLink Inc"** and location **"Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex"**. 4.2K+ followers, 500+ connections.
  - Source: Google/DDG search-result snippets. Confidence: **high**.
- Prior headline (older snapshots): **"Sales Strategy & Business Development Executive | Technology Solutions Specialist | Ex Microsoft"** — same VLink, same DFW location. Confidence: **medium-high** (search-engine snapshots of the same profile).
- About (truncated but readable via Google snippet): *"I lead enterprise sales and partnership strategy focused on cloud and AI, with a track record of driving growth in complex, high-stakes environments."* Confidence: **high**.
- No evidence found for the full name "George Anthony Dillon." A search for that name returned nothing connected to VLink or Microsoft. Confidence in "not findable": **high**.

## 2. Career background

- **Ex-Microsoft.** Headline says "Ex Microsoft," and a LinkedIn recommendation from **Carson V. Heady** states verbatim: *"I've been fortunate to work with Tony across multiple projects during our time at Microsoft. His team mentality, collaborative style, willingness to help, and customer obsession make him an invaluable asset..."* Confidence: **high**.
- **"20+ years in tech"** — verbatim from VLink's podcast page (`vlinkinfo.com/podcast/microsoft-advantage-partnerships-into-client-business-outcomes`). Confidence: **high**.
- **Channel/partner-sales specialist.** Recommendation from **Karen Bowie Washington, MBA**: *"Anthony is a dynamic channel partner specialist... A trusted advisor who is an incredible relationship builder with National channel expertise..."* (6 people have recommended him). Confidence: **high**.
- **Joined VLink around 2025** — his own post "How a recruiter helped me find my next role at VLink" is dated ~1 year ago (as of Sep 2026). Confidence: **medium**.
- **Licenses & certifications** (from his LinkedIn public profile): CompTIA A+; CompTIA Project+; ITIL v3 Foundation (EXIN); Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional; Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals; Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals. Confidence: **high** (rendered text).
- **Education: NOT FOUND.** Prior employers beyond Microsoft: NOT FOUND (LinkedIn experience section is redacted behind login; ZoomInfo/Datanyze blocked).

## 3. Location

- **Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex** (LinkedIn location). Confidence: **high**. No specific city (Dallas vs. Fort Worth vs. suburb) found. VLink is headquartered in South Windsor, CT, and the Microsoft Azure press release datelined SOUTH WINDSOR, CT —
  consistent with a DFW-based exec at a CT-HQ company. No other location signal found.

## 4. Public mentions

- **Press release** — "VLink Achieves Microsoft Solutions Partner Designation for Digital & App Innovation (Azure)," September 17, 2025. He is quoted: *"This designation reinforces our ability to deliver transformative cloud solutions that allow organizations to move beyond legacy systems..."* and listed as media contact: "Tony Dillon, AVP Solution Sales & Partnerships, VLink Inc., +1 773-398-0061."
  - Sources: einpresswire.com/article/849587564; syndicated on salestechstar.com, menafn.com, lifestyle.utv.ie, and the EIN Presswire PDF. Confidence: **high**.
- **Podcast guest** — "Tech Talk with VLink" Ep. 52, "The Microsoft Advantage: Turning Partnerships into Client Outcomes," April 7, 2026 (20:22), host Tracy Gardner. Takes: building partnerships, Azure/partner ecosystem, and "VLink Velocity" (a Microsoft-focused team). Distributed on iHeart, Spotify, Amazon Music, Pocket Casts.
  - Source: vlinkinfo.com podcast page. Confidence: **high**.
- **Webinar panelist + host** — "Architecting the AI-Ready Enterprise: Decisions That Matter," March 10, 2026, listed as "Anthony Dillon, AVP, Solution Partnerships & IT Strategy - VLink; Director & Host, Tech Webinars."
  - Source: vlinkinfo.com/webinars/smarter-azure-modernization-for-enterprises-beyond-lift-shift. Confidence: **high**.
- **VLink social content** — LinkedIn video "Cloud Partnerships Deliver Real Business Impact with VLink" (~9:59, ~5 months ago); "The Microsoft Tech Minute" video series (VLink LinkedIn, features him); Instagram @vlinkinc and Facebook VLink posts promoting the podcast. Confidence: **high** for existence, **medium** on exact dates.
- **Webinar speaker photo**: res.cloudinary.com/dthpnue1d/image/upload/v1770373028/Tony_D_dbb7b57046.jpg (alt "Tony Dillon VLink"). Confidence: **high**.

## 5. Golf / charity / personal interests

- **No golf connection found for this person.** Searches for `"Tony Dillon"/"Anthony Dillon" golf Dallas OR Texas Microsoft VLink` returned zero matching documents, and `"Tony Dillon" VLink golf` produced only unrelated hits. Confidence: **high that nothing public exists**.
- One tangential company data point: VLink's newsroom lists an old item "VLink Sponsor the 2017 Travelers Championship" (`vlinkinfo.com/resources/newsroom/vlink-sponsor-the-2017-travelers-championship`) — a VLink (not personal) PGA sponsorship in CT. Do not attribute to him.
- Only personal-interest signal found: he liked an unrelated network post about meeting Mr. T (The A-Team) and reacted to Microsoft/partner content. Not substantive.

## Things I could NOT find

- Education (school/degree).
- Specific prior employers/roles beyond "Microsoft" and "20+ years in tech."
- Specific DFW city of residence.
- Any golf, charity-tournament, or hobby tied to this person.
- Any VLink press release about the September 2026 Microsoft golf event, or any event page naming him as an attendee (the event itself is not publicly indexed).
- His LinkedIn experience section verbatim (auth-walled).
- Any confirmation of the full name "George Anthony Dillon."

- **Tony Dillon (ZoomInfo id 1574252360)** — home builder / The Dillon Group, Little Rock, AR; 30 years at AT&T. The DDG result that surfaced this ID was misleading. Different person.
- **Anthony Dillon (Chicago, IL / Vernon Hills)** — Whitepages age-60s Chicago resident. Not tied to VLink; uncertain, excluded.
- **"Tony Dillon Golf" on Vimeo** — unrelated. Excluded.
